i mean yeah. we were arguing about money stuff and i just lost it and made a comment about her body. like a low blow about her weight. i dont even believe it i just wanted to hurt her in the moment
You meant to hurt her in the moment, and now it’s sitting with you. I’m here if you want to stay with that a little longer, or leave it there for now.
the thing that gets me is i sounded exactly like my mom. she used to pick at me about how i looked constantly. swore id never do that to anyone. and there i was doing it. feels gross

honestly the first one. becoming her. like maybe im just a mean person underneath and this is proof. she apologized to me after which made it worse cause i was the one who screwed up

shame i guess. the what it says about me part. i was ready to write this app off but that question actually landed. i think i need to just apologize to her properly instead of sitting here marinating in it
